import sys

def main():
    line = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    input_chars = list(line)
    
    n = len(input_chars)
    ans = 0
    
    i = 0
    while i < n:
        j = i
        while j < n and input_chars[j] == input_chars[i]:
            j += 1
        count = j - i
        if count % 2 == 0:
            ans += 1
        i = j
    
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
